title: Segmentation Fault while importing files in background
body:
### Tested versions

v4.8.dev.custom_build [6ef60dc27]



### System information

Ubuntu 24.04 - GL Compatibility - NVIDIA GTX 1080 - X11

### Issue description

Batch changed a couple of import files to set compress_mode to 2 via external script (from lossless).
Focused Godot, changed focus back to file manager, when I changed back I noticed nothing moved.
Checked, gdb was waiting on a segmentation fault, however pressing continue made it magically go further:

### Steps to reproduce

* Create a project with many lossless textures
* Load level with a few of the textures
* Batch overwrite the .import files with compress/mode=2
* Focus Godot to trigger conversion
* Unfocus Godot
* Refocus Godot

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

-

This not a project issue given the stack trace. Can't provide the files, license-wise.
